pages.text: The $(l)Black Hole Band$() pulls dropped items to you. Craft it from string, Dark Matter and an Iron Band. It fits the ring curio slot.$(br2)Right-click to toggle it on and off, and press $(l)G$() for the same toggle from the hotbar.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)While active it drags items within about 7 blocks toward you, but only items that do not already fit in your inventory.$(li)Right-clicking a water or lava source first scoops it up like an empty bucket instead of toggling the band.$(li)On a pedestal it vacuums nearby drops and pushes them into adjacent inventories.$(li)Inside an Alchemical Chest it fills the chest from nearby drops; inside an Alchemical Bag it pulls drops to you.
